context: All 78 meanings remain task-local candidates; this part selects exact source and corresponding individual Definition/v1 review records.
goal: Prepare exact individual candidate Definition records and meanings for semantic review.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A job title alone is not a Role Profile.
A profile does not prove a case predicts success.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One employer or declared role family and level.
working_meaning.statement: An Engineering Role Profile is a versioned description of one engineering role and level, its actual tasks, critical incidents, required capabilities, working conditions and success criteria, selected before assessment design.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: The assessment score or hiring decision cannot serve as its own outcome.
One employer's outcome is not a universal best-engineer definition.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.

parameters.interpretation: Positive count of candidates selected under the policy; selection fraction is derived from the declared pool size.
parameters.name: C

working_meaning.scope: One named validation study and role context.
working_meaning.statement: A Target Outcome is a predeclared, independently observed performance criterion for role R in population P at horizon T and hiring capacity C, with raters, components and missing-data rules fixed before assessment scores are analyzed.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A construct name does not prove it can be measured.
Creativity, analysis and ingenuity remain distinct hypotheses until evidence supports their structure.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One exploratory challenge or role-linked assessment design, with the intended use declared.
working_meaning.statement: An Assessment Construct is a named capability or behavior the assessment intends to infer, with observable indicators, rival explanations, role linkage and a declared interpretation limit.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: Family membership does not establish equal difficulty.
A familiar riddle and an unreleased variant may have different exposure effects.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: Question generation, comparison and item-bank governance.
working_meaning.statement: A Case Family is a controlled set of prompts sharing an intended reasoning operation and scoring blueprint while varying surface content, constraints and exposure history.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: Editing a prompt creates a new version.
Novel wording does not establish quality or equivalence.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One frozen administration form.
working_meaning.statement: A Case Version is an immutable administered prompt sequence with source, family, allowed information reveals, timing, media, accessibility alternatives, scoring blueprint and exposure state pinned by content identity.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: The session is not the candidate or the score.
Preparation time and accommodations require explicit policy rather than silent inference.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One of at most three sessions in an assessment attempt.
working_meaning.statement: An Assessment Session is one participant's bounded encounter with one Case Version under a pinned administration policy, producing at most ten minutes of recorded answer and an attributable event history.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A response is an observation, not a trait or performance conclusion.
The recording does not grant research reuse or public release.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One session response under one purpose and consent state.
working_meaning.statement: A Candidate Response is the source recording and ordered answer events produced in an Assessment Session, with exact custody identity and participant correction history.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A transcript is not the response original.
Transcript confidence is not scoring confidence.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: Speech-to-text and participant-corrected representations.
working_meaning.statement: A Transcript is a versioned text rendering of a Candidate Response with method, uncertainty markers and corrections linked to the immutable source recording.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A rubric is not evidence of validity.
A canonical punchline cannot be the sole creativity criterion.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One formative or role-linked assessment purpose and compatible case set.
working_meaning.statement: A Rubric is a frozen set of construct-linked observable criteria, anchored performance levels, alternative-valid-answer rules and missing-evidence handling for specified Case Versions.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A scoring receipt does not prove the score is valid.
A model may suggest ratings but cannot grant employment-use authority.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: Human, model-assisted or model-generated rating under a declared method.
working_meaning.statement: A Scoring Run is a reproducible application of one pinned Rubric and scorer configuration to one pinned response/transcript input, producing criterion ratings, cited evidence, uncertainty and errors.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A challenge report cannot silently become a hiring decision.
A percentile requires an identified comparison population and calibrated forms.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: Participant feedback or separately governed employer use.
working_meaning.statement: A Score Report is a purpose-limited presentation of Scoring Run results, criterion evidence, uncertainty, missing observations, correction status and permitted interpretation.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A displayed value is not a validated ability or employment prediction merely because it is numeric.
Administrative coverage, transcript quality and completion must not be presented as candidate ability.
A metric cannot use an uncalibrated peer population as a percentile or role-fit reference.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One named metric version, report purpose, case or session scope and intended audience.
working_meaning.statement: A Feedback Metric is one versioned participant-facing value or status in a Score Report, derived from pinned case, rubric, scoring and administration evidence by a declared calculation and display rule, with its unit, missingness, uncertainty, comparison scope and permitted interpretation recorded.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A pilot engagement or satisfaction measure cannot establish hiring validity.
A score's ability to predict future work is evaluated against independent outcomes, not report views or rater agreement.
A target or dashboard color does not authorize a product claim or deployment decision.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One product capability, experiment or phase gate and declared participant, employer or study population.
working_meaning.statement: A Product Success Metric is a versioned, decision-linked measure of whether a declared product value or risk condition is met in a specified population and phase, with its numerator, denominator or outcome scale, observation window, source, missing-data rule, uncertainty, comparison and owner-selected decision rule recorded before interpretation.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: Rater agreement alone is not predictive validity.
A voluntary challenge cohort alone cannot establish employer deployment validity.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One claim, role and target-use context.
working_meaning.statement: A Validation Study is a preregistered, source-pinned comparison of assessment policies against independently specified outcomes, populations, costs and error analyses, with development and held-out evidence kept distinct.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: Higher tier is not inherited from a lower tier.
Changing role, language, model or population can invalidate an earlier tier.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: Public, participant and employer communications for one product version.
working_meaning.statement: A Claim Tier is a bounded statement of what the current evidence permits the product owner to say or use, ordered from idea through reproducibility, reliability, prediction, accepted selection and observed value.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A Purpose Choice may be recorded even when consent is not the selected lawful basis; it must not be relabeled as a Consent Record.
Challenge participation does not imply research, model-training or employment-use consent.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One participant, consent-based purpose and notice version.
working_meaning.statement: A Consent Record is attributable evidence that a participant gave or withdrew consent for one named processing purpose when the approved protocol uses consent as that purpose's lawful basis, bound to exact notice wording, scope and time.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: Self-selected challengers are not automatically representative of applicants.
Cohort membership alone does not grant data access.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One study and its analysis populations.
working_meaning.statement: A Cohort is a defined set of participants selected by declared eligibility, recruitment, time window and sampling process for one research or validation purpose.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A model score does not enact a hiring decision.
A policy is not effective until the employer and applicable owners authorize that exact use.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One role, population, employer, jurisdiction and claim tier.
working_meaning.statement: A Decision Policy is a frozen mapping from specified score inputs and uncertainty to a selection action at a stated capacity, with abstention, human review, accommodation and appeal rules.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A rating is an observation under a rubric, not a direct measure of a stable trait.
Not elicited and unknown evidence must not be converted to zero.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One response, dimension, case version, rater, mode and score version.
working_meaning.statement: A Criterion Rating is one anchored judgment about one elicited rubric dimension of one response, made by an identified rater or pinned scorer with cited answer evidence and an explicit missingness state.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A similar question scored by the same rubric is not an independent criterion.
A laboratory work sample is not automatically later job performance or the study's Target Outcome.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One validation study and declared performance domain.
working_meaning.statement: An Independent Criterion is a separately elicited and scored observation of work-relevant performance used to test whether an assessment score transfers beyond its own case, with outcome assessors masked to that score.

originating_intent: Give each of the 78 local concepts its own reviewable carrier-shaped Definition record while keeping Lab admission separate.
